description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies the contract for logging components that can output log data, possibly forming chains in a logging system. It includes a method println for outputting log entries with various parameters.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface representing a node in a logging chain that processes and outputs log data, with a method for printing log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
